project_overview: This project appears to be a Vue.js application focused on user administration and potentially e-commerce functionality. The structure utilizes several Vue components, suggesting a component-based architecture. The dependency graph reveals a relatively flat structure, with components often relying on each other for navigation and data rendering. The presence of confirmed issues suggests a potential need for improved code quality and security practices.

layers.description: Handles user interface rendering and user interactions.
Contains the core application logic and data manipulation.

macro_trends.title: Component Tag Over-Reliance
macro_trends.description: Several components (AdminSettings, DataTable, ImageGallery, PaymentForm, ProductCard, SearchBar, UserDashboard, UserProfile) are using 'component_tag' connection types, indicating a possible over-reliance on components for navigation or data retrieval instead of more structured routes or services. This introduces potential fragility and makes future refactoring more challenging.

macro_trends.title: Potential State Management Issues
macro_trends.description: The extensive component-to-component connections suggest a possible lack of centralized state management. Prop drilling across multiple components could lead to state management complexity and performance issues.

key_workflows.name: User Authentication Flow
key_workflows.description: The dependency chain from LoginForm to AdminSettings, DataTable, and UserDashboard indicates a primary user authentication flow. The route navigation connections highlight a common path for authenticated users to access administrative and dashboard features.
